import { Toolbar as P } from "@shardsui/svelte";
import type { ToolbarButtonProps } from "./toolbar.types.js";

import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";
export type ToolbarInputProps = ComponentProps<typeof ShardsToolbar.Input>;
</script>
<script lang="ts">
import { Toolbar as P } from "@shardsui/svelte";

let { ref = $bindable(null), ...props }: ToolbarInputProps = $props();
</script>
<P.Input bind:ref data-slot="toolbar-input" {...props} />

<script lang="ts">
import { Toolbar as P } from "@shardsui/svelte";
import type { ToolbarLinkProps } from "./toolbar.types.js";

let { ref = $bindable(null), ...props }: ToolbarLinkProps = $props();
</script>
<P.Link bind:ref data-slot="toolbar-link" {...props} />

<script lang="ts">
import { Toolbar as ToolbarPrimitive } from "@shardsui/svelte";
import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";
import type { ToolbarRootProps } from "./toolbar.types.js";

let { class: className, ref = $bindable(null), ...props }: ToolbarRootProps = $props();
</script>

  bind:ref

  data-slot="toolbar"
  {...props}
/>

<script lang="ts">
import { Toolbar as P } from "@shardsui/svelte";

<P.Separator
